title: Your AI Sounds Like A Press Release — Paste 1 Example 🎯

lines: You describe the style you want. A-I still writes like a press release.
Here's the usual ask. Friendly, punchy, human.
And this comes back. Corporate. Nothing like you.
Same ask — but I paste one thing I already wrote.
Same length. Same rhythm. My voice. One example did what three adjectives couldn't.
Adjectives are opinions. An example is a spec.
Got writing you love? Paste it, don't describe it. Follow for one A-I trick a day.
